captions.detailed: An independent rear trailing-arm suspension assembly. It features a long, black rectangular cross-member as the base frame, with two trailing arms connected at each end via horizontal pivoting joints. Each trailing arm extends backward and terminates in a wheel hub, which supports a realistic black rubber tire with a silver-gray metallic wheel rim. The trailing arms pivot up and down relative to the cross-member, while the wheels rotate freely on their hubs.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated independent rear trailing-arm suspension system. The model should include a main transverse cross-member, two rearward-extending trailing arms connected to the cross-member ends via revolute joints, and a wheel hub at the end of each trailing arm supporting a rotatable wheel with a black tire and a silver rim.
captions.factory: Construct a base part representing the transverse cross-member using a box primitive. Create left and right trailing arms using box and cylinder primitives, attaching them to the cross-member ends with horizontal revolute joints. Model the wheel hubs at the trailing arm tips, and attach the wheels (composed of a cylinder for the tire and a stylized hub cylinder/disc assembly) using continuous revolute joints for the axles.
